$comment: Instances of our contracts on Aztec Alpha (mainnet, Ethereum L1 chain 1). contracts: empty, no escrow or stream of ours is deployed there, so agreements stay refused (lib/aztec/agreement-policy.ts). tokens: the operator's own token HLC (11 November 2026). Alpha runs real value and, in Aztec's words, is live but early, with critical bugs expected; our contracts have no external audit. An entry is added only with its transaction hash and block, after the read-only preflight (workflow "Aztec mainnet preflight") passes for the same artifacts. See docs/MAINNET_READINESS.md.
$internalReviewComment: An internal security review is not an audit: audit stays null and the Alpha deploy gate (lib/protocol/agreement-gate.ts) still refuses. This field only points to the report.
$closedAlphaComment: Closed alpha, wave 1 (operator decisions OD-1 to OD-10, 18 November 2026, docs/alpha/OPERATOR_DECISIONS.md). lib/alpha/gate.ts lets an agreement be opened on Alpha only when enabled is true, before until, for a class listed here that is also a recorded deployment in contracts, for an AlphaMember who acknowledged the risk. Off until Stefan deploys the classes and records them; until is set then (8 weeks, OD-9). This is not an audit: audit stays null.

closedAlpha.$distributorComment: Who distributes HLC to testers (MiCA art. 4(1)(a); preliminary legal note, A.2; decision D-3). null: nobody can create invitation codes, redeem them or issue HLC (lib/alpha/rules.mjs). Stefan fills it in a PR of his own once counsel decides: { kind: 'company', legalName, taxId, registry } or { kind: 'natural-person', legalNote: { ref, signedBy, signedOn } }.

$tokensComment: Private tokens the wallet may list on Alpha (NEXT_PUBLIC_AZTEC_TOKENS must match these: scripts/aztec/check-alpha-config.mjs). key is the wallet's internal slot, never shown to users; symbol is what users see. deployBlock 0 (status pending-preflight) means not yet confirmed: the preflight (test/live/aztec-mainnet-preflight.live.test.ts) reads the block of deployTx from the node and prints it, together with the instance's class ID; both are then written here. Nothing is invented. HLC is issued by Humanity Ledger, is not backed by and has no relation to USDC.

tokens.name: Humanity Ledger Corp.
tokens.$renamePendingComment: The on-chain name sets out a company that does not exist (preliminary legal note, 19/11/2026, A.4). Stefan deploys a new instance named as HLC_TOKEN_META in lib/payments/assets.ts (docs/alpha/HLC_REDEPLOY_RUNBOOK.md); once the read-only preflight confirms it, this instance moves to retiredTokens and the new one replaces it here. Until then the preflight checks that the on-chain name equals the recorded name.
